gloss: some; some kind of; in some way

definitions.gloss: some; some kind of; in some way
definitions.explanation: Indicates an unspecified or vague something. Used when the speaker cannot or does not need to specify exactly what kind or in what manner.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}らかの{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Some kind of countermeasure is needed.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}らかの{形|かたち}で{協力|きょうりょく}したい。
examples.english: I want to cooperate in some way.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}には{何|なん}らかの{原因|げんいん}があるはずだ。
examples.english: There must be some kind of cause for this problem.

notes:
{何|なん}らか is the indefinite form of {何|なん}ら (which means "(not) at all" in negative sentences or "any" in questions).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なん}らかの + noun — some kind of [noun]
- {何|なん}らかの{形|かたち}で — in some form
- {何|なん}らかの{理由|りゆう}で — for some reason
- {何|なん}らかの{影響|えいきょう} — some kind of effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何|なに}か — something (more colloquial, concrete)
- {何|なん}らかの — some kind of (more formal, vague)
- {何|なん}かしらの — some or other (slightly less formal than {何|なん}らか)
